derivation.behavior: SQLite runtime configuration and failure semantics are explicit and portable across host packaging.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go opens SQLite with foreign keys, WAL, NORMAL synchronous mode, finite busy timeout and extended result codes; cgo-disabled builds fail explicitly with ErrUnavailable instead of selecting another store.

invariants: Native open enables foreign_keys and WAL and configures a finite busy timeout.
No-cgo builds remain compilable but Open returns ErrUnavailable.
Writer contention waits for the configured busy timeout before returning busy/locked.
Corrupt/not-a-database failures are classified without exposing SQL arguments.
